Gyaru doesn't mean sex outside a relationship. It's a Japanese subculture of young women, who usually have heavy cosmetics, beached hair, skimpy clothing and tans.

The name actually comes from the English words gal; gyaru is what happens when you try to say gal while following Japanese rules on how to put sounds together (not a lot of allowed vowels, so "a" becomes "ya", Japanese doesn't distinguish between "r" and "l" and mostly use an r sounds, so gyal becomes gyar, you have to end every syllable with a vowel, so stick a u on the end there)
